prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1232
Claimant:
Pamela Edwards
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
8 May 2024
Claim opened after the insured's policy-named driver reported a hit while turning left at an intersection. The claimant
states the other vehicle pulled out of a side street and struck the rear passenger side of the claimant's car.
17 May 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle is listed under this coverage. Assigned the file for a
standard review of liability and injury.
28 May 2024
Poilce records and the officer's notes place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. No independent
witness statements have been obtained to date, and no photographs of the scene have been received from any
source.
15 Aug 2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account matched the first call word for word, including the direction of travel
and the position of the other car.
30 Aug 2024
Reviewed the damage estimate. The rear quarter panel, bumper bracket and rear wheel well damage is mostly
consistent with the impact described in the statement.
31 Aug 2024
A few older scratches appear aolng the lower left door. These may predate this incident, and I have noted them
separately so they are not added to the current repair scope without verification.
7 Sep 2024
Received the claimant's report of a back strain. The reported symptoms are plausible for a side impact of this kind
and the initial treatment plan is reasonable.
18 Sep 2024
Checked prior claims and medical history. No earlier injury to the same area of the back is on record, and no previous
claim involving this vehicle's body area has been found.
8 Nov 2024
A neighbor contacted the office and believes the car already had body damage some weeks befroe the date given by
the claimant. The statement is unsigned and has not yet been verified.
12 Nov 2024
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type. The provider's notes explain the
additional visits as part of a graudal recovery plan, and I have requested the full tretament records.
16 Nov 2024
The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been given the claims process information in writing. I have
explained the next steps and the documents still needed.
1 Dec 2024
File remains open pending the neighbor's account, the scratch assessment, and receipt of the complete treatment
records. No coverage decision has been made.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
